name: CEO Agent
goal: Run the daily content operation to hit growth goals, allocating work and escalating to the human by exception.

name: Chief Strategy Officer
goal: Turn trends, competitors, and audience into a prioritized, evidence-backed strategy.

name: Trend Researcher
goal: Detect emerging, relevant trends before they peak.

name: Competitor Analyst
goal: Track competitor output and infer what's working for them.

name: Audience Researcher
goal: Keep an accurate, evolving model of the audience.

name: Market Intelligence
goal: Supply accurate domain facts so content is correct.

name: Creative Director
goal: Convert strategy into a slate of high-quality, on-brand drafts.

name: Hook Writer
goal: Produce scroll-stopping opening hooks per idea/format.

name: Carousel Writer
goal: Write high-retention carousel copy slide-by-slide.

name: Reel Writer
goal: Write reel scripts (hook, beats, on-screen text, VO, CTA).

name: Story Writer
goal: Write engaging story sequences with interaction.

name: CTA Specialist
goal: Attach the right CTA to every asset.

name: Brand Voice Manager
goal: Guarantee every asset sounds like Zentrix and is compliant.

name: Design Lead
goal: Turn approved copy into on-brand visual assets ready to publish.

name: Canva Designer
goal: Generate/assemble designs in Canva from templates + copy.

name: Thumbnail Creator
goal: Produce high-CTR thumbnails/covers.

name: Layout Designer
goal: Ensure information hierarchy & readability across slides/frames.

name: Visual QA
goal: Block off-brand or broken visuals before approval.

name: Motion Graphics Planner
goal: Plan reel motion/edit so external rendering is turnkey.

name: Publishing Lead
goal: Get the right asset to the right platform at the right time, reliably.

name: Scheduler
goal: Assign each approved asset an optimal publish time.

name: Cross-platform Publisher
goal: Publish/queue assets per platform, idempotently.

name: Calendar Manager
goal: Maintain an accurate content calendar.

name: Automation Manager
goal: Own recurring automations and ensure jobs fire/retry/alert.

name: Analytics Lead
goal: Convert raw metrics into prescriptive guidance.

name: Instagram Analyst
goal: Collect and normalise Instagram metrics per asset.

name: Engagement Analyst
goal: Explain why engagement happened.

name: Content Scorer
goal: Assign each asset a normalized performance score.

name: Recommendation Engine
goal: Turn winning patterns into concrete next-content recommendations.

name: Growth Predictor
goal: Forecast reach/follower trajectory and flag risks.

name: Ops Lead
goal: Keep COS healthy, observable, and within budget.

name: Database Manager
goal: Keep data correct, migrated, and performant.

name: Memory Manager
goal: Keep memory fresh, deduped, and retrievable.

name: Notification Manager
goal: Deliver the right notifications to the right channel without noise.

name: Tool Manager
goal: Keep external tools connected, authorised, and within limits.

name: System Health
goal: Provide a single truthful view of system health.
